from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentEvidence(BaseModel):
    """Extracts legal attributes from a single judgment document to enable categorization."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the case: '民事' (Civil), '刑事' (Criminal), or '行政' (Administrative)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or dispute subject (e.g., '共有物分割', '执行异议', '合同纠纷')")
    crime_charge: str | None = Field(description="If criminal, the specific charge named (e.g., '拒不执行判决、裁定罪', '帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪')")
    administrative_subject: str | None = Field(description="If administrative, the specific administrative issue (e.g., '不予受理决定', '行政复议')")
    procedural_type: str | None = Field(description="The procedural context, e.g., '二审', '再审', '复议', '一审'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentEvidence]
